## Instructions

1. Simmer the meat, onion and water about 1 hour, stirring often.
2. Add the spices, salt and pepper.
3. Let the filling cool.
4. Line two pie plates, fill and cover with the top crust. Cut slits.
5. Bake at 375°F about 30 to 40 minutes, until golden.

## Notes

Freezes well. Serve with chili sauce.
